description: This PHP interface defines the contract for a refreshable token provider used within AWS SDK. It specifies methods for refreshing tokens and determining if a refresh should be attempted.

classes.name: RefreshableTokenProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the methods for token refresh strategies in AWS SDK.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the token, returning a Token object or throwing an Exception.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Checks whether a token refresh should be attempted, returning a boolean.
